main_text.p: Idque secundum illud Sa-lomonis: judicia irriforibus se[?] parata, & plagas in gratiam stultorum.Prov.19. v.29. Et alibi: labia stulti, ve-nire cum contentione, & os ejus ad percussiones vocare.Prov.18. v.6. Præter-quam quod cogitandum foret, eum qui non facit,id quod de-bet,non recipere,quod forte æ-quitas suaderet. Præterquam quod leges talé indignum ju-dicent,aliquo humanitatis be-neficio, qui impingit in leges.

Cumque illecebra peccandi fit spes immunitatis,eaque uti dicetur, fit occasio duellorum; nihil quidem magis injuria-rum occasionem suppeditabit hominibus pessimis quam quod impune eas inferant, & faciant.Unde si judices severe injuriarum illatarum gratia in fontes & quidem citra dilati-onem animadverterent, in po-sterum sibi maledici tempera-rent , linguam refrænarent.

page.notes: The glyph before "parata" in the first line ("irriforibus (se") is unclear; read as "se[?]". The first-line "sit/fit" is read as "fit". Marginal references are printed as "Prov.19." with "v.29." beneath it and "Prov.18." with "v.6." beside the next lines; they are transcribed as two notes. Part of the page edge at the lower right is a faint digitiser watermark, which was left out.
